prompts:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: finished production hero banner for the BR893 mobile casino homepage, wide 2.5:1 aspect ratio, approximately 2000 x 800 pixels, opaque full-bleed image.
Primary request: completely remake the existing banner into a polished purple-brand campaign with extremely clear promotional typography. Image 1 is ONLY a reference for the familiar friendly tiger mascot and the offer; redesign the scenery, styling and typographic composition.
Color palette: harmonize with the actual site's plum-purple surfaces #32233f, #432f56, #503b62, lavender highlights #cfb5ee, creamy white #f7f2fa and champagne-gold highlight #ffe3a3. At least 70% of the environment should read as elegant violet/plum, visibly purple rather than near-black. Restrained muted rose #b05a85 may appear only as a tiny accent. Replace the red outfit with a refined purple jacket with delicate champagne-gold trim.
Scene/backdrop: rich softly illuminated plum and violet background with a few elegant flowing silk-like arcs and very restrained sparkles. Soft lavender rim light. No tropical landscape, no green, no orange sunset or busy piles of gold.
Composition: retain a readable text-left, tiger-right advertising composition suited to the same existing homepage banner. Text occupies about 62% of the wide canvas, tiger about 35% on the right. The tiger is a high quality charming 3D mascot with detailed fur, a confident welcoming smile, one paw extended, purple jacket, natural orange-and-cream fur. Tiger and decorative details must remain secondary to the text. Use generous 5% safety margins and no clipped words.
Exact Portuguese text, no extra copy:
"PERDAS NO JOGO"
"CASHBACK"
"SEMANAL"
"50%"
"br893.com"
Typography: The slogan CASHBACK SEMANAL and the 50% are the dominant elements. CASHBACK is a huge bold refined uppercase display headline in luminous warm ivory/champagne, with SEMANAL directly beneath it in bold champagne lettering, not thin tiny spaced letters. Put an even larger sculpted 50% below, with broad readable numerals, pale champagne-gold metallic front faces, subtle warm highlights and deep plum extrusion/shadow. 50% is the largest object in the banner. PERDAS NO JOGO is a smaller clean readable uppercase eyebrow above the slogan. br893.com is a small clean signature at bottom left. Spell CASHBACK exactly C A S H B A C K, not CASHNBACK. No other letters, claims, buttons, badges, logos or watermarks.
Style/finish: premium commercially art-directed 3D campaign, visually bold but controlled, crisp typography, high contrast in mobile thumbnail size. No excessive gold glare, no neon magenta, no cartoon text outlines, no extra percentage offers. Flat rectangular full bleed artwork, no mockup device, no outer margins or white canvas.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit this finished wide purple promotional banner.
Remove the entire bottom-left "br893.com" text and the two horizontal decorative lines directly flanking that URL. Seamlessly fill that cleared area with the existing plum/purple flowing background so the bottom has clean breathing room. Keep the 2.5:1 canvas size and composition.
Everything else must remain unchanged: the exact text "PERDAS NO JOGO", "CASHBACK", "SEMANAL", the very large gold "50%", their spelling, their size, their locations, the tiger mascot and its face/pose/purple jacket, the purple/champagne palette, the lighting and all other illustration details. Do not add any URL, brand name, substitute text, logo, caption or watermark. Make the removal invisible and professionally finished.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the provided finished wide purple cashback promotional banner. Make exactly one design change: separate the slogan color from the percentage color.
Recolor the front faces of the words "CASHBACK" and "SEMANAL" from yellow gold to luminous cool pearl SILVER-WHITE with subtle very pale lavender highlights (#f7f2fa, #e7def4, #cfb5ee). Their bevels should become silver/lavender, not yellow or champagne. Preserve their purple extrusion and dark shadows for excellent contrast. The large headline should feel bright, polished and premium, clearly a DIFFERENT color family from the 50%.
Keep the enormous "50%" richly warm metallic GOLD, exactly as it is. This clear cool silver-white headline / warm gold percentage distinction is essential.
Preserve everything else exactly: text content and spelling "PERDAS NO JOGO", "CASHBACK", "SEMANAL", "50%"; their scale and location; the tiger, pose and purple jacket; the purple background, composition and 2.5:1 canvas. Keep "PERDAS NO JOGO" white. No URL, no br893.com text, no new text, no watermark, no logos, no other layout changes.
